title: Juniper and the Machine
author: Mara Yarrow
blurb: Ines Vasquez, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
